integrity: All primary new conclusions follow from the explicitly proved prime/composite stabilizer classification and standard covering-space (co)homology results applied to the cited wedge theorem; no independent audit or priority certification is implied.
scientific_limitations: The non-two-connected graph-complex wedge theorem is prior work. The quotient is determined only below degree 2p-5, not in all degrees; the exact LS category and higher attaching maps are not computed. Finite enumeration verifies small cases only. Similar consequences may be present in unindexed sources.
title: Prime-order free symmetries and long cup products in separable-graph complexes
